'''Nile Audo''' was an associate of [[Mal Biron]], and acted as his contact on [[Nwarcol Point]] when the veteran [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] was auditioning new recruits. Audo, along with a [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droid]], provided the cargo to a crew of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] after repeating the code phrase "the [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]] are bad this month."<ref name="SSR" />
